itemList.label: Wall shelf of mugs and candles

artOrigin: Thirteen objects made with built-in image_gen.imagegen: five v1 objects retained byte-identically, eight new objects for the owner density revision. No API/CLI, purchases or external art. Approved internal adult standing stills unchanged.
rights: Project-generated objects plus project-owned approved character art; no logos, external commercial corpus, proprietary text, clinical claims or clinical inputs.
preparation: Original PNG bytes/alpha retained. Executive native Canvas preparation: uniform crop/downsample only, alpha below 8 removed from prepared copies, nearest-neighbour sampling, transparent padding, measured floor anchors and nine-row opaque bases. No recolouring, semantic repainting, source upscale, character edits or chair masks.

optionalReconciliation.reason: Move out from behind entrance balloons into upper-right display space; approach clears the measured painted base.
Keep the wall display reachable around the relocated plush bin.

doorRule: Necessary furniture isn't removed by doors. Optional decor may hide for its owned door; wall items also hide for north backing. All four standing spots stay.
